name: Flight helmet
blurb: A vintage pilot's flight helmet with goggles and an oxygen hose, on a wooden display stand.

Leather cap.info: A fitted leather cap kept the pilot warm in an open or unheated cockpit and held the earphones in place.

Goggle frames.info: The goggle frames and straps sealed out wind, oil and cold air at high speed.

Lenses.info: Tinted lenses cut the glare of the sun at altitude, where the light is much harsher.

Metal fittings.info: Buckles, rivets and the hose connector: small metal parts that hold everything together.

Oxygen hose.info: Above about 3,000 metres the air is too thin, so this ribbed hose fed oxygen to the pilot's mask.

Stand.info: The wooden stand and rubber head form the helmet is displayed on; they are not part of the helmet.
